SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN sharing_status = '已生效' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS validCount, SUM(CASE WHEN sharing_status = '已失效' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalidCount, SUM(CASE WHEN sharing_status = '未生效' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount FROM sharing_ratio WHERE deleted = 0
AND create_time BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}) AND FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
AND create_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime})
AND create_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})

SELECT sharing_type AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sharing_ratio WHERE deleted = 0
AND create_time BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}) AND FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
AND create_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime})
AND create_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
GROUP BY sharing_type ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT cooperator AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sharing_ratio WHERE deleted = 0
AND create_time BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}) AND FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
AND create_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime})
AND create_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
GROUP BY cooperator ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT cooperator, COUNT(*) AS count FROM sharing_ratio WHERE deleted = 0
AND create_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}) AND create_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
GROUP BY cooperator ORDER BY count DESC
